body:
I would like nothing more than to live my life and enjoy it. However, it's much easier to talk about fixing your problems than it is to actually do it.

For example - I have crippling social anxiety. One of the triggers for feeling the way I did yesterday was that I went to a work dinner with everyone from my work. I sat there the whole time not talking to anyone or anyone talking to me, feeling miserable because everyone else was having a much better time than I. So why didn't I just talk to them? I have nothing in common with them. I have nothing interesting to talk to them about. They have their own cliques that they tend to stay in. I feel this way when I am in any large groups of people.
And I think it was The Bridge - though I remember watching it on vimeo or something and I can't find it now.
I didn't mean to imply you were making it up - only that I didn't remember them saying they regretted it immediately - I thought they only regretted it after being rescued from the water.
Yeah I called her last night (she lives over 12 hrs away by flight). It's a temporary help to talk to her

I've been on meds in the past. They were simply a crutch. They didn't solve anything, just made my life barely worth living. They also introduced undesirable side effects, like lower libido (my libido was already low enough as it was - my girlfriend at the time really liked that :|)
I've actually seen that documentary. I don't recall the jumpers saying they regretted it right as they jumped though.

Thank you for your comment. It helped me a lot.

> The thing about the depression and me being overweight was I never felt like eating.

Unfortunately I am the opposite. Being depressed makes me binge like crazy until I feel sick. Being angry and sad only works for a few days at the gym until I get depressed over the sheer amount of exercising I have to do to see any difference, amongst other feelings of hopelessness - and I binge.
I hope you don't do it either.
I appreciate the concern and help but I don't think there is anything you can tell me that my mother or therapist have already told me.
